invocation: One required --mutation NAME per root-dispatched invocation. All fourteen names allowed exactly once through exclusive prepared-v2/name marker. No automatic loop, retry, cap increase or baseline rerun.
dependencies: Exact successful primary receipt and all artifact hashes, unchanged source/input generation identities, actual same-tree original reviewer cold clearance. Pending actual cold report schema must match recognized verdict; unknown schema fails and needs separate adapter version.
scratch: None needed: actual CLI writes unique --<mutation>.json under logs/runner-cache; no program source generation, imports of historical scripts, fabricated inputs or baseline cache writes.
success_contract: Exit exactly1, structured failed count positive, expected target family fails, stdout family/total match JSON; check totals are finite diagnostics only. Survival, abnormal exit, budget, monitor and identity failures preserved.
ordering: Dispatch before staging primary cache; current index must still equal the cold source tree. Each name dispatched separately; root stops on failure and reviews evidence.
verification: Parsed and compiled adapter AST only; inspected runner CLI/imports and output contract. No primary/mutation/science module import or gate executed.
